cohort: All Black and White pregnant people who attended prenatal screening and had a singleton birth in any Ontario hospital between April 1st, 2012 and March 31st, 2019
finding: Black people in Ontario, Canada, were at increased risk for several adverse perinatal outcomes compared to White people, highlighting racial inequities within the healthcare system.
mod_finding: Black people had lower risks of elective caesarean section and assisted vaginal delivery compared to White people.
